A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and are complete and readable, including equations, figures, tables, and appendices. Appendices A–E match across versions; v2 adds Appendix F.

before.justification: v1 reports original intervention, early-stop decoding, influence-structure, and answer-mode experiments on GSM8K, CommonsenseQA, and StrategyQA, including appendix robustness results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Sections 3–5 and the appendices, including the intervention-operator comparison in Figure 9.

M1.justification: The latent-state intervention procedure, downstream propagation, early-stop decoding, influence estimation, and probe readouts are unchanged. Rewritten descriptions and diagram labels do not introduce a new component or procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same CoT-augmented training coverage and evaluate GSM8K, CommonsenseQA, and StrategyQA. The mathematical, commonsense, and binary answer-mode scenarios remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Coconut, CODI, and explicit CoT-SFT retain the same experiment-specific participation and GPT-2, Llama3-1B, and Qwen3-4B backbones. The main-text and appendix influence comparisons add or remove no comparator.

E3.justification: The training schedules, dataset splits in Table 1, six-step budget, intervention settings, teacher-forced KL measurements, and StrategyQA filtering/readout procedures are unchanged. Equation 8's reformulation preserves the existing early-stop metric.

E4.justification: The six-operator robustness comparison in Appendix A.2/Figure 9 and the necessity, early-decoding, routing, and mode-competition analyses are retained. Appendix F adds qualifications, not a new robustness test or supplementary analysis.

E5.justification: Figure 3 retains the same error bars and uncertainty caption. Descriptions of deterministic execution, controlled randomness, and independent rollouts are unchanged; no statistical reporting procedure or run-count information is added.

E6.justification: The quantitative figure assets in Figures 3–16 are identical across versions. Flip rates, early-stop curves, influence weights, structural metrics, and superposition scores retain the same entries and findings.

T1.justification: Equation 8 incorporates infinity into the minimization set, mathematically matching v1's explicit convention that an unsolved example has k_i = infinity. The SCM, influence and structure definitions, and probe formulation otherwise remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about heterogeneous step roles, non-local influence, and the gap between output preference and representational commitment. Editorial shortening does not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: New Appendix F explicitly warns that hidden-state overwrites, especially zeroing, may cause off-manifold distribution shifts. It also limits generalization from single-step edits, T = 6, and the selected models and benchmarks. Existing mechanism interpretations remain intact.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and repository link in the abstract, providing access information absent from v1. Existing implementation and training details are unchanged; repository contents and availability are not established by the PDFs.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, and claimed relationship to prior research are retained. Reference-title capitalization corrections do not change citation membership or research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 corrects grammar and punctuation, streamlines several passages, updates the publication header, and adds a short limitations section. The overall narrative and existing section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: Figures 1–2 receive formatting and label corrections, including 'Flipped' and 'Principal,' with clearer panel headings and a revised Figure 2 caption. Text and equations reflow across pages; quantitative displays and Table 1 retain their structures.

improvement.justification: Appendix F makes the intervention and generalization limitations explicit, improving interpretation of the retained causal evidence. The new code-access pointer and corrected prose and diagrams also improve usability. These are limited gains in transparency and presentation; the empirical evidence and methods remain unchanged.
